content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered PD#23456 — rate-limiter alert. High 429 tail for tenant=acme-pay, spike started ~14:00 UTC, ~12k 429s in last 5m. Auto-escalation to SRE/group-oncall.

pagerduty-bot: PD page fired to @jordan, @maria, oncall rotation. Please ack in 5m if taking.

jordan: acked via PD. I'm taking the page, switching channel. Quick check — are we sure this is quota misapply vs limiter OOM?

maria: seeing quota-mapper logs with a lot of "no-mapping" for acme-pay around the same time. But limiter pods also show high GC and CPU. Could be dual.

anil: I can start with temporary mitigation: disable strict quota enforcement for acme-pay for 10m. Will push bypass if approved.

lee: copying metrics — p50 p95 for limiter enqueue time: 12ms / 1.2s, dropped reqs rising. Backend kube events show limiter restart loop on one node.

ops-bot: Recent deploys: rollout limiter-service v2.3.1 at 13:58 UTC to cluster-us-east-1. No immediate rollback recorded.

jordan: ok execute mitigation plan: 1) add bypass for tenant, 2) scale limiter replicas, 3) open quick rollback of v2.3.1 if needed. I'll coordinate with support for customer comms.

maria: granting temporary bypass in config console now. Command: 
```
POST /internal/quota/bypass HTTP/1.1
Host: config.internal.redwood.local
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "tenant":"acme-pay",
  "bypass":true,
  "ttl_secs":600,
  "meta":"incident PD#23456 temporary mitigation"
}
```

anil: scaling limiter deployment to 6 replicas now. 
```
kubectl -n inference scale deployment limiter --replicas=6
```

sam: verifier — running quick smoke: sending 20 parallel requests to acme-pay token route. 429s dropped from ~40% -> ~3% after bypass applied (observed in the last 30s). Will continue monitoring.

jordan: good. Maria, can you tail the quota-mapper logs while we watch limiter stability? If quota-mapper keeps misassigning tags we need a deeper rollback.

maria: tailing logs:
```
[2026-03-15T14:01:57Z] quota-mapper INFO tenant=acme-pay mapping_found=false reason=tag-mismatch request_id=abc123
[2026-03-15T14:02:02Z] quota-mapper WARN tenant=acme-pay rule_eval=error err="null-ratecap" request_id=abc124
```
Seems like a config push earlier didn't include a default mapping for an older tenant schema. That would explain quota misapply.

lee: limiter pods stabilized after scale — no restarts in last 40s. CPU back to ~55%. Still seeing some 429s from older proxies that haven't picked up bypass flag.

jordan: good progress. Next steps: 1) Keep bypass for 10m, 2) rollback quota-mapper config change from 13:55 if we confirm it caused mapping loss, 3) run a canary deploy of limiter v2.3.0 if rollback needed, 4) notify affected customers.

anil: starting rollback snapshot of quota-mapper config (13:50). If approved I'll revert.

maria: confirmed config diff — a missing default mapping line was removed in the 13:55 PR (PR#678). I'll open an emergency PR to re-add and plan for immediate apply.

ops-bot: PD update: PD#23456 status=acknowledged assigned_to=jordan. Escalation suspended.

jordan: Sam, can you prepare a brief customer note for Acme ops and our support triage? We need: what happened, impact, mitigation, ETA for permanent fix. Keep it high-level.

sam: drafting: "We observed automated quota enforcement misassignment combined with a limiter capacity spike causing elevated 429s for some requests. We applied a temporary bypass and scaled limiter pods; this restored traffic flow. We're rolling back the problematic mapping change and will follow up with a permanent remediation plan." Will share in #support-to-customer.

lee: metrics update (14:05 UTC): 5m error rate for acme-pay dropped from 38% -> 4%. Token latency p95 back within SLO. Logging still shows ~5 stale proxy nodes with cached policy; those should refresh in next minute.

jordan: nice work. Keep bypass active until quota-mapper rollback is live and proxies refresh. After rollback: run a targeted test and then remove bypass.

anil: rollback queued and will apply in 2min. I'll post the diff and the apply command here.

maria: PR#680 created to re-add default mapping. Applying now.

ops-bot: config apply started: repo=infra/quota-mapper commit=ae9f4d apply_id=apply-5590

jordan: monitoring — please ping in this thread with any regressions. Support, prep customer send at +30m if stable.

sam: sending interim note to Acme ops: "We've applied protections and restored traffic; action ongoing, will update in 30m."

lee: rollback complete, proxies are reloading policy. Post-apply logs: 
```
[2026-03-15T14:06:11Z] quota-mapper INFO tenant=acme-pay mapping_found=true request_id=abc200
```

anil: removing bypass in 5m after stability window. Will run a small canary test first.

jordan: thanks all. PD update: PD#23456 status=resolved (monitoring) after mitigation and rollback. I'll keep monitoring for 1hr. If error rate creeps up we'll reopen.

maria: note for postmortem: misapplied config change + limiter rollout correlated. We'll enumerate safeguards: config CI check for default mappings, deploy sequencing guard, and better traffic draining for limiter restarts.

sam: adding customer impact notes to incident doc: impacted: acme-pay (production), estimated requests affected ~18k over 10m, partial degradation, no data loss.

jordan: closing slack handoff — oncall remains monitoring. If anyone sees a renewed PD page, re-assign to oncall rotation. Thanks everyone :tada:
